exitStatusDetail: ONE launch drives the regression trio synchronously (m1.spike.boot 7/7, m2.bridge.smoke 6/6, m2.session 23/23) then the event-driven binding phase runs scenario m5.host-binding at 27/27 — the three v1 'unavailable' primitives are now REAL and proven on the emulator: httpFetch streaming + abort over the loopback carrier, HUKS keychain set/get/delete, presentPicker grant with user-scope fsScope persist/resolve and content-matching read-back
descriptor: 9 available / 0 unavailable — fsRead, fsWrite, fsScope (app scope C-served), httpFetch, notify, presentApproval, presentPicker, keychainGet, keychainSet (user-scope fs forwarded to ArkTS); the flip is backed by this run's on-device proofs, never declared

primitives.httpFetch: HttpPrimitive.ets over @ohos.net.http requestInStream: settles {status, headers, bodyId:<callId>} at headers, then streams the body as http.body chunk events (<=4 KB raw, base64) plus http.end onto the runtime queue; loopback bodies that beat the settle are queued and flushed after it; abort() is real end-to-end (numeric bodyId survives the bridge abort seam -> HttpRequest.destroy()). Proven against the host's own carrier: /gateway-e2e/bytes 2 chunks/64 bytes consumed chunk-by-chunk, /gateway-e2e/slow aborted after the first chunk -> iterator rejects {code:'cancelled'}
primitives.keychain: KeychainPrimitives.ets over @ohos.security.huks: AES-256-GCM fixed-alias master key (generate-on-set on first use, load-on-get), sealed blob = 12-byte random nonce + ciphertext(+tag) at <filesDir>/keychain/<sha256(ref)>; set -> get returns identical bytes, unknown ref resolves null, set null deletes. Image quirks handled: isKeyItemExist throws 12000011 for a missing key instead of resolving false; GCM decrypt needs the tag via HUKS_TAG_AE_TAG with the ciphertext body as inData
primitives.presentPicker: PickerPrimitives.ets over @ohos.file.picker DocumentViewPicker (user scope): dismissal resolves null and grants nothing; the grant binds user:<uuid> to the picked URI, fsScope.persist writes bkm:<uuid> into <filesDir>/scope-registry.json, fsScope.resolve restores a fresh handle, fsRead reads picker URIs through fileIo. The image ships an EMPTY user store and is undebuggable, so the binding phase bootstraps a seed file via the platform save dialog (driver-tapped, unique per-run name) and hands its name to the scenario as the host.seed bridge event; user-scope surface is read-only (creation needs picker.save, outside the contract select) — same proof shape as Android m4.host-binding

captures.primary: sink-capture.txt + binding-capture.txt (app-side capture files pulled via hdc file recv; named .txt because the repo ignores *.log)
captures.second: logs.txt (continuous `hdc shell hilog` stream filtered to dsh.spike lines)
captures.screenshots: m5-live-deltas.png (first token delta streaming into the mounted page) and m5-binding-complete.png (session complete rendered in ArkWeb) — human evidence only

uiAutomation: hosts/harmony/ci/run-host-e2e.sh + ci/drive-binding.mjs: polled uitest driving of the save dialog (seed bootstrap), the DocumentViewPicker close X (dismiss -> null) and Browse->My phone->seed file->done (grant), the approval Approve button, and the notification lifecycle (Home, shade, DSH E2E tap). Every wait is a polled condition with a deadline

toolchain.signing: none — the emulator accepts the unsigned debug HAP via hdc install
